name: Malga
long_description: Malga gives digital businesses access to multiple payments services through a single integration, and the ability to change between them on a transaction to transaction basis without writing code.
one_liner: Malga is an API to accept payments with multiple payment providers

founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio: Raised between Brazil and the US, and spent last 7 years across US and Europe working for tech companies.

founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio:
Majored in industrial engineering and started in the financial market working at some hedge funds in Rio de Janeiro for 8 years.
In 2015 I went to a venture builder named Finxi, began as a Project Manager and moved to Product.
In 2016 founded Medicinae Solutions, which was a startup to advance health insurance receivables. There I was responsible for the product and development team. I stayed 3 years. Medicinae had an exit, it was sold to Afya, a NASDAQ listed company.
